archetypes.name: timing-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 timing ownership changed between in-loop and deferred writers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 lint-fix main-agent path for single-writer timing behavior. Check that terminal lint stalls write exactly one round row and do not leave artifacts that record-only resume can replay Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-harness
archetypes.rationale: The launcher sandbox stubs bootstrap and generated larch-run dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the larch-run harness for realistic environment isolation, Python dispatch assertions, invalid target rejection, and resume partial-upgrade coverage. Watch for brittle assumptions about host paths or Python executables Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
